scope: All advertised remote branches/tags/PR refs plus imported local refs; all reachable raw blobs, with no binary or size exclusions.
false_positive_classification: Exact SHA-256 file hashes and browser-key fingerprints; only commit/path/rule/line fingerprints ignored.
author_email_metadata: Affected authors consent confirmed by owner; commit IDs and release tag preserved.
limits: Pattern matching cannot identify every possible credential format.
Known-value comparison covers locally available current secrets, not unknown historical values.
Unreachable remote objects and deleted external evidence are outside reachable/retained scope.
